complete_model.clocks: tau=e*t; sigma=gamma^2*tau; both complete rows use the same clock
complete_model.pressure: instantaneous complete sine and form pressure; no frozen pressure approximation
complete_model.events: one supplied phase dipole only; no support event or previous form pulse

support.local_rows: Nodes4 and5 each have degree2 and neighbors(3,5) and(4,6) on both supports; finite propagators still differ.

preparation.uncertainty: All thirty-six independent original nodewise errors, without symmetry or zero-sum constraints; no endpoint reset or source narrowing.
preparation.branch: New unprobed continuation of the original captured family. The previous uniform-form pulse experiment is not part of this state history.
preparation.unjoined_control: Prepared on two separate unit C9 rings from the same nominal source and budgets; evolved for the same original elapsed time. No contact deletion.
preparation.means: One weighted form/continuous-phase mean pair on joined support; separate pairs for each unjoined ring. Compare deviations in the full18-node degree norm after the respective mean projections.
preparation.joined_source_admission: Read-only primitive and retained-step capture audit; preserve the explicit archived Picard, local-error and endpoint-center execution premise.
preparation.control_source_admission: Each original ring has excess storage and combined squared norm at most36/65536^2, within its radius1/12 and barrier1/129600. Sum both energies; common coercivity1/4500 gives full18-node norm squared at most4500*72/65536^2<1/144.

warmup.premise: Both source families are already inside independently admitted forward-trapped acute charts. Norm caps alone do not establish trapping.
warmup.source_form_and_phase_caps: 1/12 each in own degree metric after appropriate mean removal
warmup.method: Constant degree-metric isometry and shared strict nonlinear Lyapunov kernels; no commutation or trajectory assumption
warmup.decay_upper: 2^-128, retained as an exact rational before every squared-norm comparison
warmup.duration: T=128/kappa in tau; added original time1024*T/1023
warmup.admission: Both exact returned squared norms strictly below their declared form_radius^2 and phase_radius^2
warmup.scope: Conservative finite structural duration, not a practical recovery speed or laboratory-unit claim

input.means: Every relevant weighted phase and form mean is preserved
input.work: Signed phase-potential jump, separately bounded for each model; no loss-funded reservoir or passive event claim
input.identity: Post-jump norm strictly below1/12 and excess storage below common barrier1/648000, then unforced recovery on unchanged mean leaves

observation.readout: q^T[x(h)-x_minus]; scalar q^T*x equals x4-x5 in both models
observation.window: h=probe_duration in tau after the single jump
observation.errors: Four bounded scalar q^T*x readings: before and after in each model. readout_error_bound applies to each difference-channel reading, not each individual node sensor. Total contrast error at most4*readout_error_bound.
observation.threshold: recorded contrast lower bound strictly above contrast_threshold and the phase-blind comparison upper bound

finite_response.target: Fresh correlated(2,1) compatible target, outer32/inner64 strict root refinements; acute margin>1/8 radian
finite_response.remainder: Each complete model has error E=2*h*X+4*g*a*h^2+2*g*h*Y+4*g^2*h^2*Qmax, g=1/3069, Qmax=(X+2*g*h*(Y+2*a))/(1-4*g^2*h^2). Keep both remainders and all four readout errors.
finite_response.scope: The local leading coefficient depends on acquired bulk geometry. Both different full-support propagators are bounded; they are not assumed equal.

phase_blind_alternative.complete_rows: x'=-A*x; theta'=gamma*A*x, same held capacities, support, clocks, source and supplied phase jump
phase_blind_alternative.distinction: Explicit complete-law alternative, not an unannounced parameter mutation in the sine model
phase_blind_alternative.warmup: Initial relative form norm<7/65536; heat gap>=1/90 and the same T give exp(-T/90)<=2^-128 and endpoint norm below form_radius
phase_blind_alternative.causal_response: Exactly zero pulse-minus-sham form response at equal initial form
phase_blind_alternative.raw_contrast: Retain background relaxation: absolute recorded joined-minus-unjoined increment at most4*h*X+4*readout_error_bound
phase_blind_alternative.scope: This alternative can be separated; other phase-dependent laws are not uniquely excluded.

prediction: Expect the unchanged original family after finite warmup to produce a strict positive local recorded contrast above threshold and the phase-blind bound, with positive bounded supplied work and preserved joined/unjoined winding identities.
stopping_rule: Require prior artifact association, actual joined capture and original unjoined trapping, full-metric source caps, fresh target and cosine-gap admission, finite warmup on both complete laws, both nonlinear remainders and four readout errors, strict contrast threshold and phase-blind separation, bounded signed work, strict post-jump identity and recovery. Preserve any unavailable condition; no retuning or repeated first reserved assessment.

runtime.backend: exact Fraction and fixed outward dyadic128 trigonometric target intervals
runtime.seed_scope: deterministic exact bounds, no sampled source or trajectory

scope: Conditional sensitivity to acquired internal geometry under supplied complete laws and support. Not topology-independent intrinsic identity, unique sine-law selection, autonomous event/contact selection or physical identification.
